hypothesis_origin.source: M9I2 timing-corrected genuine-source vs proxy-extra comparison
hypothesis_origin.key_structure: All 43 genuine source PRIMARY decisions had M15 RCI9 on the pullback side of zero: LONG RCI9<0 and SHORT RCI9>0. Only 8 of 41 proxy extras did.

validation_population.note: This is a temporally separate retrospective holdout. It is not prospective validation and does not establish source truth.

policies.J1_BTC_LONG_SIGN: for BTCUSD LONG only require entry_m15_rci9<0; keep every other branch unchanged
policies.J2_BTC_LONG_NEG50_SENSITIVITY: for BTCUSD LONG only require entry_m15_rci9<=-50; keep every other branch unchanged; sensitivity only
policies.J3_GLOBAL_SIGN_REFERENCE: require LONG entry_m15_rci9<0 and SHORT entry_m15_rci9>0 for all tickers; reproduction-oriented reference only
